svg.text: 1. Unit masses from the model volume, except: duct (shroud) — 16 mm skin + 15 %
stiffeners, full 360°; bulb nacelle — 12 mm shell + 20 % frames; runner hub — 60 mm
cast wall; support pylon — 20 mm plate box.
2. Section A–A cuts the unit on the vertical plane through the runner axis; the far
half is shown, cut faces hatched.
3. Flow from left to right (+X). Blades shown at the model's blade angle.
Section through the runner axis, end view, plan; bill of materials
TEACHING MODEL — materials, tolerances and wall thicknesses are assumptions. Not for construction.
